content.title: ARC Raiders New Hotfix! Connection Issues & Server Problems!
content.text: Raiders, we're back with crucial gaming news today! This video discusses the latest arc raiders update, detailing the new hotfix from Embark Ocean to address ongoing issues. We also dive into arc raiders gameplay showcasing the current performance challenges and review the new patch notes. In ARC Raiders, gameplay flows between the surface ruled by lethal machines, and the vibrant underground society of Speranza. Craft, repair, and upgrade your gear in the safety of your own workshop, before venturing topside to scavenge the remnants of a devastated but beautiful world. Play solo or in parties up to three, navigating the constant threat of ARC's machines and the unpredictable choices of fellow survivors. #arcraiders #arcraidersnews #arcraidersupdate
